home.subtitle: Freelance fullstack developer based between Lille and Grenoble. I design and build custom websites and applications, built for your business and your users — from the first brief to production.

about.title: Here's a little about
about.description: I'm a freelance fullstack developer, splitting my time between Lille and Grenoble during my engineering apprenticeship at IMT Nord Europe. For over 4 years I've been building digital tools for research labs, independents and small businesses — from the first call to going live, never leaving a project half-finished. What matters to me isn't just that it works: it's that it's clean, fast, and that you can run it without me six months from now.
about.quote: I like projects where we end up being more than just client and freelancer.

list.name: Timon Guillotin
list.comment: Téo brought Ciel Avenue to life with incredible attention to detail. His technical skills and creative vision helped us build a platform that truly simplifies real estate. Working with him was an absolute pleasure!

list.name: Axel Elias
list.comment: Couverto started as my idea, and Téo helped me turn it into reality. We share this project 50/50, and his technical expertise combined with his dedication made all the difference. A true partner in every sense!

list.name: Mayeul Deries
list.comment: Téo helped me build an exceptional website to track job applications. His professionalism and attention to detail are remarkable. I highly recommend!

list.name: Gabriel Halus
list.comment: I had the pleasure of working with Téo on the Let'sgo Lego, Paperlive, and Ahcanfut projects. It was a great experience every time. Téo naturally brings innovative ideas and always finds relevant solutions to challenges. It is a genuine pleasure collaborating with him.

list.name: Félix Picon
list.comment: Téo's boilerplate saved me hours of setup. His guidance was sharp, clear, and very useful. It was great to collaborate with someone so precise and passionate.
